title: From Størmer to Schwarzschild: Analytical Dynamics of Charged Particles in a Dipole Magnetosphere
summary: We investigate the conservative dynamics of relativistic charged particles in a Schwarzschild spacetime threaded by an externally supported dipolar magnetic field. The gravitational sector is treated exactly in isotropic coordinates, while the electromagnetic field is described by the leading asymptotic term of the relativistic exterior dipole solution. This formulation provides an analytically tractable relativistic extension of the classical Størmer problem and allows the circular-orbit and stability structure to be studied explicitly.
